theme: A light day in Maine while Mike mends.
greeting: The girls are with Jen this stretch, and the day was kept deliberately clear while Mike recovers from oral surgery. A visitor, a couple of errands, then the drive up to Rockland — the evening is unclaimed.

needsAttention.title: Amra wants to see you in New York
needsAttention.detail: On the Sustainalytics thread, Amra Balic asked to catch up in person while she's in NYC from Sep 5-11; your reply hasn't gone back yet.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sunday NYC dinner
needsAttention.detail: Mike flagged this p1 for today on the board: a table for two on Aug 23. Two people at 48 hours usually means calling for bar or counter seats rather than refreshing an app.

recipe.title: Roast Sugar-Sprinkled Peaches
recipe.why: Peaches are at their late-summer peak, when a hot oven and a little sugar are all they need.

acts.line: A visitor and a couple of errands to clear before the road.
The midday drive up to Rockland and the ferry country beyond it.
Open and unclaimed — a soft-food supper and roast peaches would suit it.
